reviews.title: Many errors
reviews.text: I only recommend the free version of the app due to the number of errors. Sometimes there are wrong answers (especially on vocab Qs). But sometimes there’s a typo such as “answer for the question mark,” but there’s no question mark in the prompt… The app was clearly not made by a native English speaker, which is fine except where it interferes with accuracy, (which feels important for this kind of app)

reviews.title: Answers are wrong
reviews.text: I am not saying this because I think I’m always right, but some of the questions only had incorrect answers. For example it asked “how many 3’s will I encounter up to fifty”. At first I thought 1, as there is only one three; but that wasn’t an option. My second thought was 5 as there is a 3,13,23,33,43; yet that wasn’t an option either. So I did 50 divided by 3, which is 16.6 recurring; but 16 wasn’t an option. The only choices I had were 11,13,15,19 so I chose 15 as it was the closest. And it was the correct answer!!! Of course the explanations are hidden behind a paywall so I couldn’t even see their reasoning.

reviews.title: Some questions are Lost in translation
reviews.text:
I think this app and questions were written by someone in Europe because it is using metric system in the questions. Possibly German because the questions seem translated. For example “Which train is the fastest at the train station”? From the choices only one train was able to get to 200km/h which is fastest arriving train at the station. Although the question should have been “Which train arrived in the shortest time at the train station”? to get the correct answer. 

In German “schnell” has two meanings: fast and shortest time. Hence “Mach Schnell”. Or “Make it short”. In English, especially in a word puzzle, that meaning of “fastest” means who is the one achieving fastest speed to break a record. It does not specify variable speeds and same arrival. 
Questions should be clear. Just m my two cents.

reviews.title: I paid. The solutions are incorrect.
reviews.text:
I was surprised to have scored so poorly. When checking it turns out the solutions to problems are often incorrect.

In some cases the solutions do not even appear in the option list. I was presented with a dart board with orange and yellow darts, and the solution to the question “what color were the darts” was “white and red”. I am confused how such errors are possible. You had one job.

reviews.title: Okay, I guess.
reviews.text: The test is poorly translated, and you are unable to choose regions such as North America, or other regions like Mexico. I also think the evaluation is flawed because of the translations and not only that, the questions in general. I took this test for fun, it said my IQ was 92. I took that for an answer, until I did an actual IQ test (WISCC), telling me otherwise. According to the WISCC IQ test, my IQ ranges from 133-136. I do think you should take this with a grain of salt, as I am a 10 year old with severe ADHD. Thanks for reading my review!
